violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -No sani bucket made at time of inspection.
Sanitizing solution testing devices. — --Test strip or kit that accurately measures the sanitizing concentration was not provided. -No chlorine test strips available at time of inspection.
Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. -Ensure that the wastewater tank is larger than the freshwater tank
